meta.title: HandyPlan — Booking Software for Craftsmen
meta.description: The simple, mobile-first booking platform built for German craftsmen. Let customers book 24/7, cut no-shows by 40% with automatic reminders, and manage your day from your phone.
meta.ogDescription: More bookings. Less stress. Zero missed calls. Built for German craftsmen.

hero.badge: The #1 booking solution for craftsmen in Germany
hero.subtitle: HandyPlan is the booking platform built specifically for German craftsmen. Your customers book online 24/7 — even when you're up a ladder or in a basement.
bullets: Save 5 hours a week — no more phone tag
Set up in 10 minutes, no complicated software

problem.title: Sound familiar?
problem.subtitle: You're not alone — 8 out of 10 craftsmen still manage appointments by phone and paper.
problem.closing: But what if there was an easier way?

items.title: Missed calls = lost revenue
items.body: You're on a job site and can't pick up. Every missed call is a customer who simply rings the next name on Google. Craftsmen lose 5–8 jobs a week this way.

items.title: Scheduling chaos
items.body: Sticky notes, a paper diary and a half-full Excel sheet. Double bookings, forgotten appointments and no clear view of your week.

items.title: No-shows waste your day
items.body: Without reminders, 30–40% of customers forget. You drive across town for nothing — that's lost time and lost money.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.subtitle: Simple, focused tools built around how craftsmen actually work — not a bloated enterprise suite.

items.title: Online booking widget
items.body: Embed on your website or Facebook page. Customers book themselves 24/7, even on weekends.

items.title: Smart calendar
items.body: Day, week and month views with colour-coded jobs. Drag to reschedule, never double-book.

items.title: Mobile app
items.body: Built for the job site. See today's schedule, navigate with GPS, works offline in basements.

items.title: Automatic reminders
items.body: SMS and email sent automatically before every appointment. Cut no-shows by up to 40%.

items.title: Customer database
items.body: Every customer, job history, note and photo in one place. Personal service for repeat clients.

items.title: Simple invoicing
items.body: Generate professional, German tax-compliant invoices in seconds, right after the job.

howItWorks.title: Get started in 3 easy steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From signup to your first booking in about 15 minutes.

items.title: Sign up
items.body: Create your account in two minutes. No credit card needed for the trial.

items.title: Set up
items.body: Add your availability and services. Copy your booking widget code.

items.title: Start booking
items.body: Share your link. Customers book themselves and you get instant alerts.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.note: No hidden fees. No setup charges. Cancel anytime.

items.a: Typically 10–15 minutes. You create your account, set your availability, add one or two services and copy the widget code. That's it — you're ready to take bookings.

items.q: Do I need a credit card for the trial?
items.a: No. The 14-day free trial requires no payment details. You only add a payment method if you decide to continue afterwards.
Yes. There are no contracts and no lock-in. Cancel with one click from your settings and you won't be charged again.
Absolutely. HandyPlan is fully GDPR compliant, hosted in the EU, and all data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
It can't happen. The booking widget only shows time slots that are genuinely free, and the calendar blocks conflicts automatically.

items.q: Can I embed the widget on my own website?
items.a: Yes. Copy a short snippet of code into your website or Facebook page, or simply share your personal booking link — no website required.

items.q: How many SMS reminders are included?
items.a: SMS reminders are included on the Professional and Premium plans. Starter uses email reminders, and you can add SMS at any time.
Email support is included on every plan, priority support on Professional, and dedicated phone support on Premium.
